content.title: The Tornado Alley Is Moving. Here's Why
content.text: Tornado Alley is shifting - and it’s not by accident. Powerful storms are striking places that rarely saw them before, while traditional hotspots are seeing changes no one expected. From warming temperatures to shifting jet streams and rapid urban expansion, new forces are quietly redrawing America’s tornado map. In this video, I’m breaking down the hidden drivers behind the “New Tornado Alley” - and what it means for the future.
